children: reported third-quarter 2026 net income of $1.917 billion, or $9.04 per diluted share, and core income of $1.947 billion, or $9.18 per diluted share. The company posted a consolidated combined ratio of 86.8% and underlying combined ratio of 84.1% for the quarter, and returned $1.769 billion of capital to shareholders including $1.508 billion of share repurchases. Book value per share was $141.48 at September 30, 2026, and adjusted book value per share was $172.47.
Core income (Q3 2026): $1.947 billion; core diluted EPS: $9.18.
Total revenues (Q3 2026): $12.412 billion; net written premiums (Q3 2026): $11.480 billion.
Investment results: net investment income (Q3 2026) $1.098 billion pre-tax ($908 million after-tax); net realized investment losses in the quarter $34 million pre-tax ($30 million after-tax).

Capital returns: $1.769 billion returned to shareholders in Q3 2026, including $1.508 billion of share repurchases; book value per share $141.48 and adjusted book value per share $172.47 as of Sept. 30, 2026.
Underwriting performance: underwriting income of $1.432 billion pre-tax in Q3 2026; underlying underwriting income pre-tax of $1.736 billion.

Loss development and catastrophes: net favorable prior year reserve development totaled $234 million pre-tax for the quarter (including a $295 million addition to asbestos reserves), while catastrophe losses, net of reinsurance, were $538 million pre-tax for the quarter driven by severe wind and hail events.
Segment production — Business Insurance: net written premiums $5.868 billion in Q3 (up 3% year-over-year), with strong retention (86%) and record new business of $699 million in the quarter.
Segment growth — Bond & Specialty: net written premiums $1.209 billion in Q3 (up 12% year-over-year), with notable growth in Surety and improved renewal trends in Management Liability.

Personal Insurance dynamics: net written premiums $4.403 billion in Q3 (down 7% year-over-year primarily due to prior-year Canada operations divestiture); underlying combined ratio improved, while higher catastrophe activity weighed on segment results.
